topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecturer and outlines the core learning objectives of the lecture.

topics.label: Origins and Risk Factors of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the fundamental origins of cancer through the interplay of intrinsic genetic processes and environmental exposures.

topics.label: Infectious Agents in Carcinogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the role and mechanisms of infectious pathogens in driving oncogenesis.

topics.label: Chemical and Physical Mutagenesis Mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how physical and chemical agents induce DNA damage directly or via host metabolic activation.

topics.label: Tumour Promotion, Inflammation, and Host Susceptibility
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how tumor promoters, chronic inflammation, and host developmental context drive malignant progression.

topics.label: Methodologies for Identifying Carcinogens and Assessing Risk
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the experimental and epidemiological methodologies used to identify carcinogens and assess exposure risks.
